evidence_sentence: It validates the name length and ensures the total size matches expectations.
rationale: The fixed implementation uniquely adds a check requiring size to equal sizeof(outarg) + outarg.namelen + 1. The vulnerable implementation checks only that size is at least sizeof(outarg), then copies the name payload without validating that the total message size matches the header-declared name length. The sentence explicitly describes this fixed-only total-size validation.
rewritten_docstring: The function allocates a buffer for the name, checks the validity of the input size, and copies data into an output structure. It validates the name length and processes the associated name data. It then retrieves the name, computes its hash, and attempts to reverse the invalid entry in the FUSE filesystem. Finally, it cleans up resources and returns the appropriate error code or success status.
